g.text: All private passenger operations require an authenticated owner; admin actions require ADMIN.

text.style: font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px;fill: rgb(8%,14%,25%); stroke:none;

g.text: Public help is also available to visitors. Admins also have their own account and support access.

text.style: font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px;fill: rgb(8%,14%,25%); stroke:none;

g.text: Automatic expiry, promotion and retries are internal system behavior, not additional human actors.

text.style: font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11px;fill: rgb(34%,40%,49%); stroke:none;

g.text: Associations show access to use cases, not execution order. The assistant cannot independently book, pay, cancel or refund.
